ownership_reason: Only the per-field loop sees individual fields and their modifiers; once a transient value has been appended, the builder's running total cannot be taken apart, so the walk, the registry guard and the field fetch cannot recover the hash with a one-line change (lang3 has no utility that filters a Field[] by modifier, and forcing the flag at a hop has no effect when the loop ignores it). The rule is pinned outside the gold: the facade's javadoc says transient members are ignored unless testTransients is true; EqualsBuilder.reflectionAppend and CompareToBuilder.reflectionAppend apply '(useTransients || !Modifier.isTransient(f.getModifiers()))' in the same field loop; ReflectionToStringBuilder.accept rejects transient fields unless appendTransients; their passing tests (testReflectionHierarchyEquals, testReflectionHierarchyCompareTransients, ToStringBuilderTest testReflectionHierarchy) assert it.
